description: This file defines the 'TemplateCurrency' class, which extends 'TemplateRange' to implement currency-specific field behavior in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for saving, deleting, and retrieving database definitions for currency fields, and manages associated currency IDs.

classes.name: TemplateCurrency
classes.description: A class representing a currency field template, with properties and methods to handle currency data, including save and delete operations, and database type generation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the currency field and its associated currency ID from the database by calling parent delete and then deleting the related TemplateCurrencyId.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the currency field, formats the default value, and creates an associated currency ID label within the definition.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array with appropriate precision, including parent class's field definitions.

methods.name: get_db_type
methods.description: Returns the SQL data type string for the currency field, considering specified length and precision.
